description: List the alert rules in your workspace: each says what it watches (a schedule, a saved test or a batch, named by targetLabel), what it alerts on (failed runs, M of the last N), whether it is enabled or muted, its state now (OK or IN_ALARM) and since when, and the email destinations it sends to with their verification status. misconfigured is true for an enabled rule with no verified destination, which means nobody is told. Takes no parameters. Use when: the user asks what alerts are set up, whether something is alerting, or why nobody was emailed. Read-only. Needs notifications:read. Only a person signed in to the nopaque web app can call this (the in-app assistant); an API key is refused.
name: listAlertRules

items.description: An alert rule as the API returns it. Internal join keys, and who else asked for in-app alerts, are left out.

targetLabel.description: The name of what the rule watches

title: List Alert Rules
